name: Arayes
description: A spiced meat filling stuffed and grilled in pita bread.

name: Arroz Con Pollo
description: Hispanic rice and chicken in one pot from a ridiculously customizable formula.

name: Baby Back Ribs
description: Oven-baked ribs covered in barbecue sauce.

name: Barbecue Shredded Chicken
description: Chicken thighs “braised” in a pan, and shredded for use in sandwiches or pizza.

name: Birria Tacos
description: High-collagen beef, usually chuck roast, braised with hispanic dried chilis and spices. Bangs in a taco, burrito, or bowl.

name: Black Bean Burgers
description: Burgers made of mashed black beans. Can be seasoned however you want, or even used as a meatball. Dehydrate the beans first!

name: Carbonara
description: A pasta noodle in a creamy egg and parmesan sauce with pork.

name: Calzone
description: An Italian oven-baked folded pizza.

name: Carnitas
description: Braised shredded pork shoulder marinated with oranges and spices.

name: Char Siu (Chinese Barbecue Roast Pork)
description: Guangdong district roast barbecue pork. Tastes good on its own, but is best when used in fried rice, bao, or stir fries.

name: Chicken Marsala
description: Chicken breast in a mushroom + marsala wine sauce.

name: Chicken Wings
description: Cooked chicken wings.

name: Chili
description: Hearty ground beef and bean chili. Super hands off, and also you don’t need everything, just the beans, tomatoes, and main spices.

name: Curry (North Indian)
description: Super basic spiced north indian curry. Serve with rice.

name: Empanadas
description: Ground beef wrapped in flaky dough. Can be fried or baked.

name: General Tso's Chicken
description: Sweet and spicy breaded or fried chicken dish.

name: Tomato Soup
description: Tomato soup! Eat this on a wooden rocking chair and you will time travel back to the summer of 1897.

name: Grilled Cheese
description: Savory grilled cheese. We recommend combining with Tomato Soup!

name: Eggs Benedict
description: Poached eggs and taylor ham on english muffins topped with a hollandaise sauce.

name: French Toast
description: Bread marinated in a milk and egg mixture overnight, fried in butter and topped with honey or syrup.

name: French Scrambled Eggs
description: Eggs cooked slowly over low heat to make a creamy scramble. Great on toast!

name: Hash Browns
description: Diner style, crispy grated potatoes. Good as a side for eggs or pancakes.

name: Pancakes
description: Customizable pancake mix. Add in blueberries, pumpkin pie spice, chocolate chips, etc. and serve with breakfast.

name: Souffle Pancakes
description: Smaller and taller pancakes that rise a lot thanks to whipped egg whites.

name: Tamago Kake Gohan (Egg Rice)
description: Eggs, but in rice. A bit like carbonara.

name: Hong Shao Rou (Red Braised Pork Belly)
description: A shanghai-based red braise using caramelized sugar and soy sauce. Pork belly is the most common, but it works with literally whatever.

name: Linguini Alla Arrabiata with Seafood
description: Linguini with arrabiata (spicy tomato sauce) with seafood.

name: Macaroni and Cheese
description: Macaroni and cheese using a bechamel, then cheese, then starch from the pasta to thicken.

name: Meatballs
description: Balls of meat. italian style.

name: Pad Thai
description: Rice noodles with a tamarind-based sauce, plus protein and peanuts.

name: Paella
description: Spain rice dish using sofrito and pretty much any seafood protein.

name: Pan-Fried Chicken Cutlets
description: Pretty much fried chicken, if it wasn't deep fried.

name: Pasta Aglio e Olio
description: Simple olive oil, garlic, and chili flake spaghetti.

name: Pasta Alla Assassina
description: Pretty much fried spaghetti risotto in a super reduced tomato sauce.

name: Pesto Ears and Sausage
description: Easy comfort food that tastes really good and comes together in literally the time it takes the water to boil and the pasta to cook.

name: Pho
description: Heart warming vietnamese rice noodle soup. amazing for a rainy or sick day.

name: Pizza
description: Basic pizza guide, customize the crust size, toppings, and everything.

name: Ramen
description: The general method for ramen soups. Use this to make literally any flavor.

name: Risotto
description: Super creamy pan cooked rice.

name: Shrimp Linguine
description: Very simple shrimp linguine with a creamy sauce. Consider making a roux or bechamel for the sauce, replacing butter for boursin.

name: Smash Burgers
description: Burgers. Smashed.

name: Steak
description: A perfectly seared and roasted steak with a juicy interior.

name: Stromboli
description: Pizza, except it's a burrito.

name: Tonkatsu
description: A breaded pork cutlet with tonkatsu sauce, best served with a thinly sliced cabbage salad.
